params.text: Xeenu ubayyoou. Mannaakkati otobisu uurranobaan saa'llii qorabayyoou.
Orophphilli maransaanchuti te burra'aanchut deegarata dimbaabita affeeu. Matit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu Otobisu hakkaneneeti da'llibee.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Rosisaanchu bonxaguda dimbaabita affeeu, Lamit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu Otobisu hakkaneneeti da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Suuqi zazzalaanchut gamballata dimbaabita affeeu. Sasit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu. Otobisu hakkaneneet? Da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Ichchata sholano manchu burtukaan aguda dimbaabita affeeu፤ Shoolit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu Otobisu hakkaneneet? Da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Haakiinchu wojjuta dimbaabita affeeu Ontit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu, Otobisu hakkanneneet? Da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Hogai galaanchu bullata dimbaabita affeeu, Lehit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu Otobisu hakkanneneet? Da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou Polisichchut roozababagudata dimbaabita affeeu፤ Lamalit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu Otobisu hakkanneneet? da'lli.
Xeenu ubayyoou Giira ka'llixxi hujataanchu samagudata dimbaabita affeeu፤ Hezzeetit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu. Otobisu hakkanneneet? Da'lli. Muuziiqi alaphphaanchut biishshata dimbaabita affeeu.
Xeenu ubayyoou. Honsit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu. Otobisu hakkanneneet? da'lli!
Xeenu ubayyoou. Misila keisaanchu hamaraggeemata dimbaabita affeeu. Tordumit dimbaabit biddiqiteeu. Otobisu hakkanneneet? Da'lli!
Dimbaabita afeen Otobisii aazi aagu dandeesanoba'a› Yeeu, Otobisi shufeerchu
Xeenu ubayyoou ፤ Otobisaantasi martaa mannaakkat dimbaabissa agurti Otobisaan saa'llitoou.
Torduminti dimbaabit bobiri aleen chalalitoou ፤ Otobisunkusi uurreebiichchi keo ፤ Arriichchuti gomi aazeen caakkitoou
